profile.reading: This Data4 facility, coded WAW1, is located at Przyparkowa 21, 05-850 Jawczyce, Poland, roughly 20 minutes from central Warsaw, on a campus the operator own page also lists as home to a second building, WAW2. The operator own page gives combined campus totals of approximately 4 hectares and 60 MW of available IT power but does not break these figures down by individual building, so no building specific capacity or square footage is attributed to this record. Data4 is a data center operator founded in 2006 and headquartered in Paris, France, operating campuses in France, Italy, Spain, Poland, Germany, and Greece.
